LanguageData.FB_Necrotizer.label: necrotizer
LanguageData.FB_Necrotizer.description:
An area-denial device that induces necrosis in living tissue without touching machinery or animals. Around it the flesh cover dies and rots, and fleshmass walls rot with it. Anything absorbed back inside its field is simply killed again while the machine still runs.
The field widens for a few days and then holds. It will not spread past that ring, but nothing inside it can be reclaimed until the machine is destroyed.
